verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents API credentials, created under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date. Per-endpoint permission names such as "Monitor and unmonitor customers" and "View roles in account" suggest operation-level scoping, which supports least-privilege credentials an agent could use. However, the full permission model, its granularity and the scope-to-endpoint mapping are only implied rather than documented in depth. missing for 10: documented catalogue of credential permission scopes and how they map to endpoints, explicit least-privilege or per-agent credential guidance, rotation/revocation details, independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped credentials enforce restrictions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: These can be generated in the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can also configure their permissions and optional expiry date.
You need the "View roles in account" permission to use this endpoint.
